typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath_INB as string (),
	ArvhiveFile_INB as string (),
	EmailMessageBody_Failure as string (),
	EmailMessageBody_Success as string (),
	EmailSubject_Failure as string (),
	EmailSubject_Success as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	FILE_MTH_YR as string (),
	File_Name as string (),
	File_Naming_Convention as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	LOAD_DATE as string (),
	OutboundFile as string (),
	OutboundPath as string (),
	RecordCnt as integer (),
	SuccessEmail_IB as string (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Column 0} as string,
		{Column 1} as string,
		{Column 2} as string,
		{Column 3} as string,
		{Column 4} as string,
		{Column 5} as string,
		{Column 6} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LOAD_DATE = $LOAD_DATE,
		FILE_MTH_YR = $FILE_MTH_YR,
		FILE_NAME = $File_Name) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LOAD_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DSC_ACTION as string,
		DSC_MESSAGE as string,
		HDR as string,
		TXN_NUMBER as string,
		FILE_MTH_YR as string,
		INCOMING_RECORD as string,
		FILE_NAME as string,
		ID_MEDICAID as string,
		ERROR_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		LOAD_DATE,
		DSC_ACTION = {Column 4},
		DSC_MESSAGE = {Column 6},
		HDR = {Column 0},
		TXN_NUMBER = {Column 1},
		FILE_MTH_YR,
		INCOMING_RECORD = {Column 3},
		FILE_NAME,
		ID_MEDICAID = {Column 2},
		ERROR_CODE = {Column 5})) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
